extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Cross-media conversion engine: 2D art, 3D models and engine formats, deterministic over MCP. One operation core bridges media formats from code-first records — the factory (one identity record, emitted as 2D or 3D), canon records under lane law, anchored generation, and named, verified converter chains between formats. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Lumen does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Lumen

skills.description: Engine status and the admitted-model roster, and image generation through pinned templates: text-to-image, image-to-image, and regional image-to-image with per-region masks, holds, and strengths (lumen_status, lumen_models, lumen_txt2img, lumen_img2img, lumen_img2img_regional).
skills.name: Generation lane

skills.description: Report a project sprite's dimensions, colour type, and alpha presence, and validate a PNG against the Light Show atlas contract (sprite_info, validate_atlas).
skills.name: Sprites and atlases

skills.description: List and apply named style grade presets to .lumen.json documents and to a VRM avatar's embedded textures, and inspect VRM files (style_list, style_apply, vrm_grade, vrm_inspect).
skills.name: Style grading

skills.description: Resolve canon handles, gate an artifact's measurements against a canon record, run anchored generation (a job requires a canon handle and keeper anchors — there is no unanchored mode), and convert project art under a governing canon record; lane law is enforced (canon_resolve, canon_gate, canon_generate, canon_convert).
skills.name: Canon factory

skills.description: Probe a Bevy Remote Protocol endpoint and classify it (bevy_discover), and upload generated media to a Hugging Face dataset from a manifest with SHA-256 assertion before upload and LFS read-back verification (hf_dataset_upload).
skills.name: Engine discovery and dataset upload
